title: Headless TTW Walking With Spirits (DLC04MQ02): from Desmond's offer through the cathedral's intercom and the Mother Punga's seed in the bog to Jimson's welcome (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Given: the player out of Vault 101 (MQ01 10) with The Local Flavor done (DLC04MQ01 200: the ttw-dlc04mq01-the-local-flavor chain). That stage's script starts DLC04MQ02 and sets 5 [observed]; done here directly so this chain runs alone. The player stands on Point Lookout's landing (DLC04LookoutLandingMarkerREF, where the voyage puts the player [observed]).

Path: Desmond's offer (DLC04DesmondOffer, Offer2A, Offer3A: stage 10), the Ark and Dove Cathedral's intercom (DLC04TribalEntry1A, 2B: stage 50, the bog's door unlocked), the Mother Punga's seed pod in the bog (150, the hallucination), its end (180: the player wakes by the cathedral, the head scar), and Jimson's welcome (DLC04WakeUp1A: 200, Hearing Voices at 10).
Travel stand-in: up the road to Calvert Mansion and Desmond.

actions.label: what do you want me to do about the Tribals

actions.text: Travel stand-in: across the swamp to the Ark and Dove Cathedral's gate; its intercom (DLC04CathedralIntercomREF) answers.

actions.label: intercom: who lingers at the threshold

actions.text: Travel stand-in: through the bog's door (DLC04BogDoorREF, unlocked by stage 50) to the Mother Punga; the seed pod (DLC04PungaSeedPodSCRIPT [observed]) sets 150 when taken, then its spray knocks the player out and the hallucination starts.

Travel stand-in: through the hallucination (Mister Burke's lines, the ghouls, the bobbleheads) to its end; its trigger (DLC04BogHallucEndTriggerSCRIPT [observed]) sets 180: the player wakes by the cathedral (DLC04BogAwakenMarker) with the head scar, Jimson beside.

actions.label: jimson: your mind has been expanded
